proposals.observation: 2 sessions hit the quiz intro_load step in 48 hours; 0 started, 0 completed. Every visitor who landed on the quiz page left before answering question 1. The drop is at the very first interaction — the start trigger — not mid-quiz. This is a copy or friction problem on the intro screen itself.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the quiz intro headline and CTA button text to be more specific and lower-stakes. The current framing likely makes the quiz feel like a test or a big commitment. Replace with a grounded, curiosity-led one-liner that names the ICP's exact situation and a button that removes the sense of being evaluated.
proposals.current_text:
Find out your money personality
Start the quiz
proposals.new_text:
You earn well. So why does money still feel unresolved?
See what's underneath (takes 2 minutes)
proposals.impact: Converts at least 1 of every 2 intro-loaders into a quiz start

proposals.observation: The WoW - Money Vigilance automation has the highest open rate of the three sequences at 57.14%, yet it has the smallest send volume (7 sent vs 15-16 for the others). This suggests the segment or entry point feeding Vigilance is under-trafficked relative to its resonance with the audience.
proposals.proposal: Add an explicit 'Money Vigilance' result path callout to the quiz results page and/or the quiz intro copy, so more quiz completers are routed into this sequence. Also verify the automation's entry trigger is not accidentally gated behind a tag that few people receive.
proposals.new_text:
You got: Money Vigilance — the pattern where carefulness tips into quiet anxiety.

This is one of the most common patterns in people who earn well but still feel on edge about money. The next few emails will look at the story beneath that vigilance — and what it might be protecting you from.
proposals.impact: Increases Vigilance sequence entry and sustains the 57% open rate across a larger list
